facts_raw.Foundshore Verdict: 低优先级 / 仅特定场景
facts_raw.Funding / Support: US$500K to all admitted startups + 90+ perks/deals
facts_raw.Funding Trigger: Investment/KYC begins immediately after acceptance; typically wired 1–2 weeks after paperwork/KYC and before program start
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: $500K at $5M post-money via SAFE + 1:1.25 token side letter
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: Crypto/AI startup; any stage may apply; full commitment during 3-month program.
facts_raw.Strong-to-Have: 全职创始团队；清晰 founder-market fit；可演示产品/MVP；真实用户/客户验证；明确下一阶段里程碑与融资用途。
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: 3 months; current application lists in-person onboarding in New York City.
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: Alliance says it supports founders with immigration/visa challenges and connects them with immigration attorneys; no guarantee of government outcome.
facts_raw.Application Materials: 通常需团队/公司/产品/市场/traction/融资信息；具体以当期官方申请表为准。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: 官方申请入口优先；若官网未公开联系人，不建议猜测个人联系方式。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: Crypto / Web3；阶段以 Pre-seed–seed 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司
